suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on a Friday, no rollback drama waiting for me on Monday.
I'm thankful for the imam keeping the Isyak jemaah moving so I still caught the last LRT home.
I'm grateful for my grandmother slipping an extra piece of kuih into my bag without even asking if I wanted one.
I'm thankful for a stack trace that actually pointed to the real bug instead of sending me on a two-hour wild goose chase.
I'm grateful for the mamak still being open when the craving for maggi goreng hit at midnight.
I'm thankful for waking up already alert before Fajr, no snooze button negotiation required.
I'm grateful for a teammate who caught my typo in the production config before it went anywhere near main.
I'm thankful for the LRT carriage being half empty on a day I really wasn't in the mood to stand.
I'm grateful for a client invoice clearing a day early, right when the car insurance renewal was due.
I'm thankful for my cousin still calling instead of just texting, even when there's nothing urgent to say.
I'm grateful for a flaky test that turned out to be an actual timing bug worth fixing, not just noise to silence.
I'm thankful for the office aircon finally getting fixed after three weeks of sweating through stand-up.
I'm grateful for rezeki showing up as a referral bonus right when the laptop fan started making that dying-bird noise.
I'm thankful for the rain starting right after I got the laundry in, not one minute before.
I'm grateful for a pull request getting approved with just one small comment instead of the usual essay.
